description.value:
You gain proficiency with medium armor and martial vibroweapons, or, if you're already proficient with medium armor, with heavy armor instead. You can also apply Sneak Attack damage with any weapon that lacks the heavy or special properties.

Finally, you don't need advantage on the attack roll to apply Sneak Attack as long as no creature besides your target is within 5 feet of you and the target is below its hit point maximum; every other rule for Sneak Attack still applies.
